scenes.text: Imagine you are scuba diving deep in the ocean and you suddenly discover an actual lake with its own shoreline, waves, and sandy beaches, thousands of feet underwater.

This isn't science fiction, because these underwater brine pools actually exist, containing water up to five times saltier than the ocean around them, making it sit on the seafloor like a separate, toxic pond.
Because there is zero oxygen here, any curious creature like a crab that accidentally crawls inside is instantly pickled alive and perfectly preserved forever in a watery grave.
It looks like a peaceful oasis but it is one of the deadliest traps on Earth, so would you ever dare to explore this deep? Let me know below and follow for more!
